highlights: Dedicated Safeguarding Team and Designated Safeguarding Lead (DSL)
Whole-school approach to child protection and student wellbeing
Staff safeguarding training and safe recruitment policies
First aid and accident insurance supplement included
safety.policy_summary: VCIS is committed to creating a secure, caring, and inclusive environment where every child is protected from harm and supported in their physical, emotional, and social development. The school implements a comprehensive Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy led by a Designated Safeguarding Lead and Deputy Safeguarding Leads, ensuring strict reporting procedures, regular staff training, safe recruitment practices, and pastoral care.
